reviews.t: Love this tape!
reviews.x: I love this hair tape.  Why is it so hard to get?  It was in every drug store, dime store and convenience store in the 50's.  It was also inexpensive.  Has woman's hair changed so much that they no longer care about "fly-away" hair?  Let me think.  Oh, yes.  Hair dressers (buticians) would rather have you come in more often then to tell you that hair tape holds your hair over night, even if you are like me, a tossy turny sleeper.  Get this tape.  Fashion your hair the way you would like it to lo

reviews.t: Use it for WRINKLES!
reviews.x: I am in shock right now!  I am 39 years old and have had a vertical wrinkle between my eyes since I was 32.  I used all kinds of wrinkle creams, but it kept getting deeper and longer.  When I would look in the mirror, it was the first thing I noticed.  I seriously thought about Botox, but then I read somewhere that you can use hair setting tape on your wrinkles over night when you sleep.  Last night was the first time I used it, and I am amazed.  I simply tore off a piece that was a little longe

reviews.t: Very disappointed!!
reviews.x: I have been looking for this tape for over a year and I was willing to pay 26.00 for ONE roll, when I used to pay 5.00 at my sally's supply store!  When I received the tape I was hopeful to find it the same as I have used for myself and for clients - but it is dried out and has little adhesive to hold the hair.  I will not reorder and hopefully will find a tape to use for this same purpose.  Very disappointed!!

reviews.t: HAir Tape use with CPAP machines
reviews.x: This product works well for men with moustaches who need to use a CPAP machine for breathing at night.  The tape placed over the moustache and onto the face produces a smoother seal than if it is not used.  It also prevents the moustache hair from becoming unruly due to the CPAP face mask sliding around during the night and rumpling the moustache hair.

reviews.t: Rip Off
reviews.x: My mother has used this tape for many years.She is 93. When I couldn't find it in the store I ordered it. The amount you receive for the price is a rip off. You pay $30 for something that was in the store for $6 for the same size. I will not buy again. Virginia McCurdy

reviews.t: Pink hair tape sticking ability.
reviews.x: I don't find  the Scotch Pink Hair Tape  to be as sticky  as  it was a few years ago. Wonder if they are using a different formula?

reviews.t: Scotch Pink Hair Tape Has Multiple Uses
reviews.x: Over the years I've used this tape mostly for my hair. However, I discovered that it has a lot of other uses. When I couldn't find it any more in a store, I ordered it on line. It appears to be hypo-allergenic and makes a great bandage. Because it's so thin yet strong, you hardly notice you're using it. It's also quite waterproof so it doesn't come off until you want to remove it.  Wrap it around a sore toe or finger from a paper cut to protect it. It's great instead of Scotch Tape and you can w

reviews.t: Great product but ridiculous price.
reviews.x: I have used this hair tape for years.  I have bangs and it's the best way to control them after I wash my hair.  I couldn't find it anywhere and then  Amazon had it.  The price was insane but I can't get along without it.  Why it cost so much I'll never know.  In my eyes it was robbery but I needed it.  I used to be able to buy it at a sensible price.

reviews.t: just as I emembered it -- almost
reviews.x: Years ago I used this in lieu of bobby pins to fix damp hair in place as it dried.  I was very happy to see that I could use it again, but.....  It doesn't hold as well this time around. I wind up with it on the pillow and not on my hair as often as not.  I am disappointed, but still glad I found it to try again!

reviews.t: Great for sewing. Great for dating leftovers
reviews.x: I'm so glad I looked on Amazon for Scotch Hair Tape!  I haven't seen it in grocery or drug stores for at least a dozen years.  This works wonders for sewing in zippers!  Sticks to zippers and fabric, yet easily removed when project is done.  Also, works great to mark leftovers with a date when you store them in plastic ware. Easy to remind you when you first prepared or opened any food item. Doesn't leave any sticky residue- just be sure to remove tape before putting item in the dishwasher.

reviews.t: It is great for holding hair in place while it dries
reviews.x: This tape works very well. I had looked for it all over the place and couldn't find it. It is great for holding hair in place while it dries, especially if you have an area that just doesn't want to stay where you put it. The tape holds it while it dries and it then stays put. It doesn't stay if the humidity is high. Humidity is hard on any hairstyle.

reviews.t: Great for needlepoint
reviews.x: I don't know what most people use the tape for, but I use it for needlepoint.  It is wonderful for keeping threads out of the way when you are working on another part of your project.  It doesn't leave a sticky residue, it's easy to use and it lasts forever.

reviews.t: Pink Hair Tape
reviews.x: The pink hair tape, which I've been using for decades, is not as good as it used to be.  It sometimes tears when unreeling and, worst, it comes double half the time.  However, I need it so I put up with it.  A Klemme, Basking Ridge, NJ

reviews.t: I worked very well, but under the circumstances it ...
reviews.x: I worked very well, but under the circumstances it was way too expensive. Several years ago I was able to purchase three rolls for about the same price that I paid for one. I likely will not do so again.  Harry P. Hewitt

reviews.t: Love the hair tape. Hate the too hoping price.
reviews.x: Exactly the same tape that I used and liked fifty years ago. I would like to be able to continue using it. However, I think that asking $26.00 is overpricing by about 500%.

reviews.t: Five Stars
reviews.x: Works well to keep my cowlick in line!  Does not rip hair out when removing.

reviews.t: I've been using this since the 70s
reviews.x: I've been using this tape since I was a teenager in the 1970s because I have a strong cowlick in front and my bangs don't stay down.  I grew out my bangs for about 15 years but just cut them again and I found my tape in a drawer but needed to buy more.  This is the BEST and withstands blow dryers with a diffuser and I can sleep with my bangs taped as well.  Thanks Amazon for stocking it for us.

reviews.t: Great tape!
reviews.x: I love this tape--enough to pay postage to have it sent to me by mail. It helps me control the shape of my hair--especially around the face-- when I blow dry. I have been using it for years and will perish if they ever stop making it!

reviews.t: Good for hair tape, but not wrinkle eraser
reviews.x: I was hoping to tape away my frown wrinkles, but they seemed even worse the next morning.  I sure wish it had worked for me!  I didn't want the stiff frownies, but maybe that's what makes them work (haven't tried them).

reviews.t: I have been using it for YEARS and love it. Those damn curls on the side of ...
reviews.x: Why is this tape so hard to get?  I have been using it for YEARS and love it.  Those damn curls on the side of my head won't stay down unless I put this tape on while I am driving to work!  Love this tape.

reviews.t: don't bother
reviews.x: bad product, or just old  the adhesive was so weak it wouldn't stick  the packaging looked old, so I feel I got ripped off  I didn't bothere to return it but I guess I should have for what it cost

reviews.t: Tape is alright, but too expensive. I was ...
reviews.x: Tape is alright, but too expensive.  I was very surprised to see how small the roll was for $25.00.  I used to buy it at Sally's Beauty Store for $6.00 same size.  I feel that I was really taken.

reviews.t: The quality was not what I expected. However I ...
reviews.x: The quality was not what I expected. However I am stuck  i n buying this tape because it is the only place I am able to purchase it.

claims.text: Many reviewers complain about the extremely high price compared to what it used to cost in stores, calling it a rip-off or price gouging.
Reviewers frequently note the product is hard to find in stores and are glad to have found it online.
Several reviewers say the tape is not as sticky or holds less well than it used to, with some finding it dried out or tearing.
Reviewers praise the tape for holding hair in place while it dries and for controlling fly-away hair.
Reviewers describe a variety of other uses, including sewing, needlepoint, bandaging, and CPAP seals.
